entities.name: Richard S. Arnold
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Richard Sheppard Arnold was a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Arkansas and the United States District Court for the Western District of Arkansas and then a United States Circuit Judge of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
